title: Базовые карты и феи
prompt:
Make ONE contact sheet 1536x1024 with a strict 3-column by 2-row grid of SIX distinct, equal-size square illustrations in exact top-left to bottom-right order. Each tile has a thin black border; straight black gutters at exactly one-third, two-thirds and halfway; no external margins. True hand-pixeled pixel art on roughly 128x128 logical grid per tile upscaled nearest-neighbor; visible crisp square pixel clusters, no anti-aliasing, no painterly blur, very little fine noise, optional ordered dithering only in large shadow areas. Dark fantasy swamp-woodland adventure like classic low-resolution pixel art. Use only 3 dominant color groups deep ink navy, muted moss green, and bone silver with occasional amber/lavender accent; about 24-32 colors maximum per tile and few values per hue. One clear light source. Deep atmospheric silhouettes and excellent thumbnail readability: one focal object with a readable silhouette, uncluttered field, stronger contrast on focal shapes than background. No captions, numbers, letters, UI, or watermark; don't render any of this text in the art. Each scene has a different shape/layout. Grounded believable anatomy and functional construction wherever there is an object or mechanism. Do not draw any adventurers, player characters, elves or visible player hands on this sheet. Named animals and tiny fae are the only creatures allowed.
TOP LEFT — A practical dark steel spearhead piercing a mossy practice stump, one clean ivory crescent behind the blade, small scattering of bark. No person or hands.
TOP CENTER — A round shield built from overlapping bark slabs, rope lashings and a metal rim, braced against a rooted oak; a slanted blow kicks off bark chips. No person.
TOP RIGHT — A narrow earthen woodland trail clearly winding around a boulder into moonlight, with three pale steps or stones leading into depth. Empty landscape.
BOTTOM LEFT — Three small winged pale mint fae rise from a split acorn resting on a moss stump, strong clean silhouette grouping. No human or elf.
BOTTOM CENTER — A clear circular ring of seven mushrooms and little mint lights on the forest floor, slightly overhead view, only one pale glow in the center. Empty of people.
BOTTOM RIGHT — One large amber firefly on the tip of a bent blade of grass, a tiny second speck far back, still blue-black marsh. Readable enlarged insect silhouette.
